Plain-language privacy

Privacy Policy

Arcade MD is designed to work without an account, advertising, analytics, or third-party SDKs.

Effective September 12, 2026

In short: Your gameplay statistics stay on your device. Arcade MD does not operate an account system or developer server and does not use your data for tracking or advertising.

Information stored on your device

Arcade MD stores gameplay statistics such as games played, correct answers, total answers, scores, and best streaks locally on your device using Apple’s UserDefaults storage. These statistics are used only to show your progress inside the app.

Arcade MD has no user accounts. The current version does not sync gameplay statistics between devices.

Permissions

The current version does not request access to your location, camera, photo library, microphone, contacts, health data, or other device sensors.

Services, purchases, and sharing

The current version does not connect to a developer-operated backend, use third-party services, or include in-app purchases. If you choose to share a rank card, iOS sends the image and prepared text only to the app or person you select. If you choose to submit a question, your email app opens a prepared message; nothing is sent unless you send that email.

Developer collection, analytics, and advertising

Arcade MD does not include analytics, advertising, or third-party SDKs. The developer does not receive your gameplay statistics or usage activity. The app does not sell personal information or use it for cross-app tracking.

Retention and deletion

Your gameplay statistics remain on your device as part of the app’s local storage. The current version does not include an in-app reset control. Removing Arcade MD and its stored data through iOS removes these locally stored statistics. Because the developer does not receive this data, the developer cannot recover it.

Medical content

Arcade MD is for education and entertainment only. It is not medical advice and is not a clinical decision-support tool. Do not use the app to diagnose or treat a medical condition or to make decisions about medical care.

Children’s privacy

Arcade MD is a general-audience app and does not knowingly collect personal information from children. Because the developer does not operate an account or analytics service, the app does not ask users to provide their age.

Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated if Arcade MD features or data practices change. The effective date above will be revised when an updated policy is published.

Contact

For privacy questions, visit the Support page or email tobias@frech-online.net.
